ICYMI - my take on Kimmel’s death wish defense earlier with Carley and Todd:


Gunther Eagleman™ (@GuntherEagleman)

🚨 Jimmy Kimmel just got absolutely torched for his disgusting “joke” about Melania Trump.

Kimmel on live TV: “Look at Melania, so beautiful… you have a glow like an expectant widow.”

Melania fired back: His hateful rhetoric is meant to divide America. It’s not comedy, it’s deepening political sickness.

Kimmel’s lame defense? “It was just a light roast about Trump being almost 8

Wouldn’t Chuck have to have an actual job to even cover a Trump event?


Chris Cillizza (@ChrisCillizza)

"I'm not going to any more events where Trump is at them. I don't feel safe." --@chucktodd

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/ChrisCillizza/status/2048798698176446756#m

“…a comment on his show.”


Brian Stelter (@brianstelter)

Now we're right back to where we were last September, with the government (in this case the president's wife using her @FLOTUS account) pressuring Disney's ABC to punish Jimmy Kimmel over a comment on his show. Another free speech test is underway.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/brianstelter/status/2048781327202144559#m

Outside of those with chronic TDS, there isn’t a soul on the planet who believes this was the intent of Kimmel’s “joke.”


Defiant L’s (@DefiantLs)

Jimmy Kimmel: "I said, 'our first lady Melania's here, look at her, so beautiful. Mrs. Trump, you have a glow like an expectant widow. Which, obviously, was a joke about their age difference... It was a very light roast joke"

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/DefiantLs/status/2049008208316870790#m

Called it. And no, Jimmy… that wasn’t remotely the intent of your “joke.”


Jorge Bonilla (@BonillaJL)

KIMMEL DEFENDS THE JOKE: "I said, 'our first lady Melania's here, look at her, so beautiful. Mrs. Trump, you have a glow like an expectant widow. Which, obviously, was a joke about their age difference- and the look of joy we see on her face every time they're together. It was a very light roast joke about the fact that he's almost 80 and she's younger than I am. It was not by any stretch of t

George Conway’s perpetually-filtered GF having a bad night here on Piers’s show…


Ally (@AllyJKiss)

That moment Jo Jo from Jerz found out the shooter was a fan of hers and retweeted her X posts.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/AllyJKiss/status/2048886285914308819#m

Keep going, Mary…




Mary L Trump (@MaryLTrump)

I can't believe we're even having this conversation: In the last ten years, NOBODY has engaged in more violent political rhetoric than Donald Trump.



— https://nitter.net/MaryLTrump/status/2048918827514171396#m

Enjoy the ratio on this one…


Brian Stelter (@brianstelter)

>> @JakeTapper: "This crusade against Kimmel was predictable because the Trump administration's attempt to use Saturday's shooting as justification to stop all critical coverage, whether journalistic or comedic, of Donald Trump, that started even before the ballroom emptied..."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/brianstelter/status/2048885270959751446#m

This is post-third assassination attempt, mind you…

Hakeem should be censured. Seriously.


NRCC (@NRCC)

Moments Ago: A visibly agitated Hakeem Jeffries says “I stand by” calling for “maximum warfare” against Republicans.

“You can continue to criticize me for it, I don’t give a damn about your criticism!”

Unhinged.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/NRCC/status/2048848755466653971#m

So here’s how this is gonna go tonight with Jimmy: 

- Will accuse Trumps of trying to “silence him.” 

- Will lecture about the First Amendment and free speech 

- Will evoke fascism/authoritarianism 

- Will not apologize and double down instead 

Seals in audience will applaud.


Breaking911 (@Breaking911)

Jimmy Kimmel: "Our First Lady is here. Mrs. Trump… you have a glow like an expectant widow."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Breaking911/status/2048517635088773466#m

Kimmel makes a “joke” about the First Lady being widowed soon and here’s BS already teeing up Kimmel as the victim. Again. 

Then again, it was Brian who led a conspiracy theory about Melania’s whereabouts once while she was ***recovering from kidney surgery*** - so it’s par for the course. He never apologized.




Brian Stelter (@brianstelter)

The First Lady wants ABC to take action against Jimmy Kimmel:



— https://nitter.net/brianstelter/status/2048781014491636200#m

This is as self-absorbed as the reporter who once shared he’s suffering from PTSD after the Butler assassination because he feared he would be killed by Trump supporters after Trump himself got shot.


Chris Cillizza (@ChrisCillizza)

"I'm not going to any more events where Trump is at them. I don't feel safe." --@chucktodd

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/ChrisCillizza/status/2048798698176446756#m
